items.text: Giants officially ruled out QB Jaxson Dart (knee); Jameis Winston replaced him.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game, walked off but ruled out
items.implication: Winston in for rest of MNF; Dart status for future TBD
items.opportunity: Backup QB usage; potential Nabers/others volume shift if prolonged

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants; Najee Harris active for Giants debut.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, missed practices, true GTD resolved inactive
items.implication: Davante Adams featured; TE Parkinson and depth WRs (Mumpfield etc) for pivots
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Adams and Rams TEs/WRs behind him

items.text: Dallas Goedert sprained MCL, expected to miss a few weeks; Eagles sign Zach Ertz to PS with intent to promote.
items.why: MCL sprain confirmed via tests after exiting Week 2
items.implication: Multi-week absence; Mundt/Ertz next up; target redistribution
items.opportunity: TE snaps to Mundt/Ertz; potential WR targets to DeVonta Smith/Wicks

items.text: Jayden Daniels imaging done, consulting specialists; Marcus Mariota expected to start Week 3 vs Seattle. Daniels out at least Week 3.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (repeat), no fracture, further eval
items.implication: Mariota starts; timeline unclear post-specialists; pass-catchers hit
items.opportunity: Mariota volume; monitor McLaurin/Diggs efficiency drop

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.why: Cracked rib optimism and flak jacket; Harvey hamstring not expected
items.implication: McConkey startable with docks; Harvey handcuff/Coleman opportunity
items.opportunity: McConkey routes/targets; Coleman carries if Harvey out

items.text: Malik Nabers questionable to return (shoulder) then returned to the field.
items.why: Shoulder injury early, cleared to return mid-game
items.implication: Nabers available rest of MNF despite early scare

items.text: Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel, will rehab (surgery possible); out several weeks, likely IR, midseason return possible.
items.why: Heel re-aggravation, rehab over immediate surgery
items.implication: Multi-week absence for Colts WR; IR likely

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess: Parkinson flex pivot preferred; else Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford at WR.
items.why: Nacua inactive creates vacuum in Rams attack

items.text: Chargers placing David Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) on IR.
items.implication: Gadsden or other TEs elevated snaps/routes
items.opportunity: TE opportunity for remaining Chargers options on Herbert dropbacks

items.text: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring pull, likely miss some time; Tyson Bagent backup. Encouraging MRI, not ruled out Week 3.
items.why: Right hamstring non-contact, MRI encouraging but miss time
items.implication: Bagent likely Week 3 start vs Eagles; Bears offense impact

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes Week 2. Opportunities 36-12 through two weeks. Tucker active no snaps.
items.implication: Irving lead back locked; Gainwell diminished
items.opportunity: High snap/route share, goal-line potential for Irving

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson punished with playing time after another fumble (7th in 31 games); NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs Henderson juice
items.implication: Henderson more involved; Stevenson role risk

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27%/38% target shares first two games, leading WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model
items.implication: Must-start WR1 with Goedert out potentially boosting further

items.text: Long Sunday injury watchlist: Williams (hamstring), Daniels (elbow), Barkley (stinger), Goedert (knee), Evans (hip minor), Reed (head), Dobbins (ham), Brooks (groin), Dowdle (toe), Njoku/Kolar, etc.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and backups elevated (e.g. for Barkley, Dobbins)
